description.value: The World Largest Goat Walk is a striking wooden roadside attraction at Log Barn 1912 in Armstrong, BC, standing 30 feet high and 60 feet wide and visible for miles along Highway 97A. Built by a Mennonite farming family on a property anchored by an original 1912 barn, the site is home to seventeen goats and four horses. The adjacent farm store sells artisan smoked meats, old-fashioned baked goods, cheeses, jams, and candy — making it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Okanagan corridor on Hwy 97A.
